page_title: NOT 3-1 LEE | Nottingham Forest v Leeds 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jarred Gillett has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Matz Sels is prepared and dives to thwart him.

90+1' A terrific piece of skill by Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
90+1' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Lucas Perri no chance!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' Referee Jarred Gillett is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Nottingham!
89' Celebrations by Nottingham are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
88' Jack Harrison (Leeds) brings his opponent down. Jarred Gillett has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
88' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Morgan Gibbs-White and he is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).

85' The corner lands on the head of Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
85' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
84' Leeds can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.
84' The attendance is 30708.
82' Substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson is replaced by Jack Harrison (Leeds).
82' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Pascal Struijk (Leeds) replaces Jaka Bijol.
81' Daniel James (Leeds) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Leeds win a corner.
81' Daniel James (Leeds) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
79' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post.
79' Daniel James (Leeds) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Matz Sels easily deals with the threat.
78' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Lucas Perri comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
74' Brenden Aaronson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Daniel James (Leeds).
74' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) replacing Lukas Nmecha.
74' That's the end of the game for Sean Longstaff, who is replaced by Joel Piroe (Leeds).
73' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
73' The ball is cleared after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
71' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

68' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Omari Hutchinson and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Lucas Perri was helpless.
66' Anton Stach (Leeds) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
64' The corner kick from Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
63' The possession of the ball – 52:48.
61' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor Jesus departs the field of play to be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
59' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez will be replaced by Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham).
59' Substitution. Ibrahim Sangare did his best and is replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
51' Leeds failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
48' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Nottingham have a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Lucas Perri blocks a long-range effort from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) towards the middle of the goal.
45' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:1.
41' Yellow card. Murillo (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
41' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is hurriedly cleared.
39' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
38' Wonderful movement by Nottingham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
33' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
30' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
26' A cross from Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Leeds are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Dan Ndoye (Nottingham), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.

17' What a great effort! Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
15' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
15' Half-chance! Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Lucas Perri reacts well to snuff out the attack.

13' 0 - 1 Goal! Brenden Aaronson finds Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom left corner. Fantasy football! 0:1.
12' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Lucas Perri stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
12' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

12' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
11' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Nottingham earn a corner.
6' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
3' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) takes a short corner kick.

2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Leeds will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett was nominated as the referee for this game.
